name: Toomine Ririsu
source:
Hobbies: Singing.
Likes: Grandma, lollipop candy.
Hates: When the other person does not react immediately to her actions or words.

A second year student at Sumisora High School. (Third year student in Memories Off 6: Next Relation) Ririsu is [url=/c13500]Shio[/url]'s childhood friend and [url=/c13502]Chisa[/url]'s best friend. She moved away for a few years and when she came back to Sumisora. Upon moving back, her personality had taken a 180 degree turn.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_6:_T-wave]Wikipedia[/url].]
